title: Timeout Config Schema + Validation
description:
Timeout Config Schema + Validation
- Model: opus
- Effort: normal
- Skills: typescript-expert, system-architect
- Files: src/core/config-types.ts, src/core/config.ts, src/core/config-validator.ts, tests/core/config-timeout.test.ts
- Scope: src/core/, tests/core/

### Description
`.deckent/config.json`'a `timeout` bölümü ekle. Yapı:

```typescript
// src/core/config-types.ts
export interface TimeoutConfig {
  docker_min_timeout: number;       // default 1200, validation >= 300
  docker_max_timeout: number;       // default 7200, validation <= 14400
  tmux_min_timeout: number;         // default 900, validation >= 300
  tmux_max_timeout: number;         // default 5400, validation <= 14400
  subprocess_min_timeout: number;   // default 600, validation >= 300
  subprocess_max_timeout: number;   // default 3600, validation <= 14400
  effort_base: {
    low: number;     // default 600 (10dk)
    normal: number;  // default 1200 (20dk)
    high: number;    // default 2400 (40dk)
  };
  loc_scaling_enabled: boolean;            // default true
  history_scaling_enabled: boolean;        // default true
  runtime_extension_enabled: boolean;      // default false (Sprint 146'ya bırakıldı)
}
```

`src/core/config.ts` `loadConfig()` return değerine `timeout: TimeoutConfig` ekle, default values 3-layer merge'de uygulansın. `src/core/config-validator.ts` aşağıdaki kuralları check etsin:
- `effort_base.high > effort_base.normal > effort_base.low` tutarlılık
- `<backend>_max_timeout > <backend>_min_timeout` her backend için
- `<backend>_min_timeout >= 300` (5dk altı reject)
- `<backend>_max_timeout <= 14400` (4h üstü reject)

### Test (4 test minimum)
1. Default config'in `timeout.docker_min_timeout === 1200` döndürmesi
2. `effort_base.high < normal` invalid → throw
3. `docker_min_timeout: 100` invalid → throw "min_timeout must be >= 300"
4. CLI `deckent config set timeout.docker_min_timeout 1500` PASS, set timeout.docker_min_timeout 200 FAIL

**Kanıt:** `npx vitest run tests/core/config-timeout.test.ts` 4/4 PASS, `tsc --noEmit` PASS, `node dist/cli/entry.js config set timeout.docker_min_timeout 1500` exitCode 0.
